dreamteamer.title: UI (React)
dreamteamer.description: The dreamteamer UI in React, over the same host contract as @dreamteamer/ui: the nav, lists, boards, calendars, maps, record pages and the schema editor — one React app that a host mounts over a transport (postMessage in the VS Code extension, HTTP under dt web). Ships a library build, a browser page build, the module frames' guest and its source. A library: no collection, no verb.
